evidence: 2026-10-01: real signup through the Agent Vault proxy using this recipe (vault-minted password), with browser egress through the owner's tunnel on a US network. sso.crunchyroll.com/register takes the email and password on one page; with a test-inbox address (agentmail.to) Create Account was answered 200 by the site's own requests but nothing followed — no redirect, no account (a sign-in with those credentials was answered 401). With an address on the account owner's own domain the same submit was followed by redirects (307, 302, 307, 200) to a page with a verify-your-email notice and a Premium offer. The account owner opened the verification link, and a fresh sign-in on sso.crunchyroll.com/login with the same credentials was answered 200 and redirected into the signed-in site. Read with the staging network log (#734).
gotchas: The register page asks for the email and the password together (role=textbox named Email Address and Password); Create Account stays disabled until both are filled. The older email-first form is gone.

Crunchyroll refuses some email domains without a message: on 2026-10-01 an agentmail.to test-inbox address got 200 responses and then nothing (no redirect, no account, the password field cleared). The account owner's own domain was accepted.
After signup the page asks to verify the email (a link sent by email, which belongs to the account owner) beside a Premium / free-trial offer; the offer is optional.
Sign-in is sso.crunchyroll.com/login with the same Email Address and Password boxes.
